response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, but lacks the core requirement of 5-10 years hands-on C++ development on Windows. His only C++ exposure was a brief ~6-month stint in 2014-2015 writing C/C++ components for an IDE, plus a bachelor's thesis project on Linux. There is no SQL Server or Oracle experience, and while he worked at a fintech (RIDE Capital), the tech stack there was Node/JavaScript/TypeScript/GraphQL, not C++, and no fixed income or derivatives domain knowledge is evidenced.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) and communication skills evidenced by talks/workshops
Fluent English and some exposure to financial services company (RIDE Capital)
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months in 2014-2015), far short of the 5-10 years required
No SQL Server or Oracle database experience listed
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain expertise despite one fintech role using unrelated tech stack

key_factors.factor: No fixed income/capital markets domain expertise
